name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefit: Free short-term skill training (usually 2-6 months) with a government certificate and placement help
summary: For school or college dropouts and unemployed youth aged 15 to 45. Courses range from electrician and tailoring to drones and IT; each course has its own minimum class.

requires.en: you have finished or left full-time study
requires.ta: முழு நேரப் படிப்பை முடித்தவர் அல்லது நிறுத்தியவர்
requires.hi: आपने पूर्णकालिक पढ़ाई पूरी कर ली है या छोड़ दी है

how_to_apply: Register on Skill India Digital Hub, pick a course and a nearby training centre, and join the batch.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefit: Paid on-the-job training with a monthly stipend from the company (minimum roughly Rs 6,800-12,300 depending on qualification after the 2025 revision; government shares part of it; verify on portal)
summary: Apprenticeships in companies for people aged 14 and above (18 for hazardous trades) who have passed Class 5 or above, including ITI, diploma and degree holders.
how_to_apply: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal, search for openings near you and apply; the company signs an apprenticeship contract with you.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
provider: Ministry of Education (Boards of Apprenticeship Training), Government of India
benefit: 6-12 months of paid training with a monthly stipend of about Rs 10,900 for diploma holders and Rs 12,300 for graduates (rates from April 2026; verify on portal)
summary: Apprenticeships for diploma holders and graduates (engineering, B.A., B.Sc., B.Com and others) who passed recently, usually within the last few years.
documents: Diploma or degree certificate and marksheets
how_to_apply: Enrol on the NATS portal with your diploma or degree details, then apply to companies listed there.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
provider: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
benefit: Free skill training (3-12 months, often residential with food and uniform) and placement in a job
summary: For youth aged 15 to 35 from poor rural families (for example MGNREGA worker or SHG households, or ration cards for the poor). Upper age is 45 for women, SC/ST and persons with disabilities. In Tamil Nadu it is run by the State Rural Livelihoods Mission.

requires.en: you are from a poor rural family and not in full-time study
requires.ta: ஏழை கிராமப்புறக் குடும்பம், முழு நேரப் படிப்பில் இல்லாதவர்
requires.hi: आप गरीब ग्रामीण परिवार से हैं और पूर्णकालिक पढ़ाई नहीं कर रहे

documents: Ration card / MGNREGA job card / SHG proof
how_to_apply: Contact your block office or Mahalir Thittam office, or a DDU-GKY training centre, to join the next batch.

name: PM Internship Scheme
provider: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
benefit: Monthly stipend (Rs 9,000 after the 2026 revamp, earlier Rs 5,000) plus a one-time Rs 6,000 grant, for an internship in a top company (verify on portal)
summary: For young people not in full-time education or a full-time job, who have passed Class 10, Class 12, ITI, diploma or a degree. Age limits were widened in 2026 to 18-25. Not for families with a government employee or a member earning above the income limit.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM Internship portal, choose up to a few internships near you, and wait for the company's offer.
deadline_note: Rounds open a few times a year

name: PM Vishwakarma
provider: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
benefit: Rs 15,000 toolkit voucher, 5-7 days training with Rs 500 a day, and collateral-free loans of Rs 1 lakh then Rs 2 lakh at 5% interest
summary: For self-employed artisans aged 18+ in 18 traditional trades such as carpentry, blacksmithing, pottery, tailoring, masonry, goldsmithing, cobbling and barbering. One person per family; not for government employees.
how_to_apply: Go to your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to register; the panchayat verifies that you work in the trade.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
provider: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME
benefit: Bank loan with 15-35% subsidy on project cost (up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service units); higher subsidy for rural, SC/ST, OBC and women applicants
summary: For anyone aged 18+ starting a new small business. Class 8 pass is needed for projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) or Rs 5 lakh (service).
documents: Class 8 or higher marksheet (for larger projects)
how_to_apply: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal with your project report; after bank approval you attend a short entrepreneurship training.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
provider: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: Business loans without collateral: Shishu up to Rs 50,000, Kishore Rs 50,000-5 lakh, Tarun Rs 5-10 lakh, Tarun Plus up to Rs 20 lakh for those who repaid a Tarun loan
summary: For small non-farm businesses such as shops, tailoring, repair, food stalls and services, for anyone 18 or older.
documents: Business plan or quotation for machines
how_to_apply: Go to any bank, small finance bank or MFI branch with your business idea and documents and ask for a Mudra loan.

name: Stand-Up India
provider: Department of Financial Services / SIDBI, Government of India
benefit: Bank loans from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for a new business
summary: For SC/ST and women entrepreneurs aged 18+ starting a new (first-time) business in manufacturing, services, trading or farm-related activities. Every bank branch must give at least one such loan to an SC/ST and one to a woman.
how_to_apply: Register on the Stand-Up Mitra portal or visit a bank branch; you can also get handholding help there to prepare the project.

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS)
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefit: Free or very low-cost vocational training near your home (tailoring, beauty, electrical, computer basics and more)
summary: For people aged 15 to 45 who never went to school, learned to read later, or left school before Class 12, with priority for women, SC/ST, minorities and rural poor.

requires.en: you have left school or are not in regular study
requires.ta: நீங்கள் பள்ளிப் படிப்பை நிறுத்தியவர் அல்லது வழக்கமான படிப்பில் இல்லாதவர்
requires.hi: आपने स्कूल छोड़ दिया है या नियमित पढ़ाई नहीं कर रहे

how_to_apply: Find the JSS centre in your district on the JSS website and visit it to join a course.

name: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefit: Free online courses and certificates, and one place to find PMKVY, NAPS and JSS training and jobs
summary: A free government portal and app where anyone can learn skills online, get certificates, and find training centres, apprenticeships and jobs.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the Skill India Digital Hub website or app with your mobile number and start a course.

name: Tamil Nadu 7.5% Reservation for Government School Students in Professional Courses
benefit: 7.5% of seats in medical, dental, engineering, agriculture, veterinary, fisheries and law courses kept for government school students, and the government pays their tuition, hostel and counselling fees
summary: For students who studied Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools. The 7.5% applies inside every category (horizontal reservation), so you still need to qualify (e.g. NEET for MBBS).
documents: Certificate from headmaster that you studied Class 6-12 in government schools
how_to_apply: Tick the 7.5% government school quota option when you apply for TNEA or medical counselling and upload your school study certificate.

name: Naan Mudhalvan
provider: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Free industry skill courses, career guidance and competitive-exam coaching
summary: Tamil Nadu programme for school students (career guidance from Class 9) and college, polytechnic and ITI students (skill courses with companies, built into the semester).
how_to_apply: Register on the Naan Mudhalvan portal with your college or school details and choose the courses offered to you.

name: TNSDC Skill Training Programmes
provider: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Free short-term skill training with certification and placement support at centres in every district
summary: Tamil Nadu skill training for unemployed youth (usually 18 and above) in trades such as electrician, welding, tailoring, healthcare, retail and IT.
how_to_apply: Visit your District Skill Training office or register on the TNSDC website to find a course near you.

name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
provider: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: 25% capital subsidy on project cost (cap raised over the years; latest notices mention up to Rs 75 lakh) and 3% interest subvention for projects of Rs 10 lakh and above; extra subsidy for SC/ST and differently-abled (verify on portal)
summary: For first-generation entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu with a degree, diploma or ITI, aged 21 to 35 (up to 45 for women, SC/ST, BC/MBC, minorities, ex-servicemen, transgender and differently-abled), living in Tamil Nadu for 3+ years. Includes free entrepreneurship training.
documents: Residence proof (3 years in Tamil Nadu)
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Tamil Nadu MSME portal; the District Industries Centre calls you for an interview and training.

name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
provider: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: 25% subsidy on project cost (up to Rs 3.75 lakh) on a bank loan for a small business (verify on portal)
summary: For unemployed youth in Tamil Nadu aged 18 to 45 (up to 55 for special categories) who passed Class 8, with family income up to Rs 5 lakh a year, to start a small manufacturing, service or business unit.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Tamil Nadu MSME portal; the District Industries Centre recommends your loan to a bank.

name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
provider: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: 35% capital subsidy (up to Rs 1.5 crore) and 6% interest subvention on business loans (verify on portal)
summary: For SC and ST entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu starting or expanding a manufacturing, service or trading business. No minimum education.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Tamil Nadu MSME portal; the District Industries Centre helps you get the bank loan.
